newsitem.title: USA: Westmark Group says to sell to Green Tree.
newsitem.headline: Westmark Group says to sell to Green Tree.

text.p: Westmark Group Holdings said Friday it has added Green Tree Financial, one of the nation's largest sub prime mortgage lenders, to its list of major investors who buy its sub prime loans.

The chief executive officer of Westmark Mortgage, the primary subsidiary of Westmark Group holdings, Mark Schaftlein said, "We are pleased that, after thorough review and due diligence, the loans we are originating at Westmark Mortgage have been found to meet the exacting underwriting criteria and quality control standards of such a recognized industry leader as Green Tree."
Westmark said Green Tree is now among a list of investors buying "B" and "C" rated credit loans from it.
